title: Add agency-related SQLAlchemy models to chatbot/db/models.py
description:
Extend chatbot/db/models.py with agency-related SQLAlchemy model classes: AgencyRitual, AgencyTimeline, InitiativeSettings, and Notification. Add these as new model classes following the existing model conventions in the file.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/db/models.py (existing model classes — understand base class, column conventions, import style, and existing table naming patterns)
- chatbot/agency/initiative.py (created by task a.4 — understand the InitiativeLevel enum values for column constraint)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/db/models.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Implementation:

1. Inspect chatbot/db/models.py to understand: base class (Base = declarative_base()), import style, __tablename__ convention, id column convention, column naming style.

2. Add four new model classes after the last existing class:
  a) AgencyRitual (table agency_rituals): id (PK matching project convention), user_id (String(64), nullable=False, index=True), name (String(255)), ritual_type (String(64)), cron_expression (String(128), nullable=True), message_template (Text), enabled (Boolean default True), metadata (JSON, nullable=True), created_at (DateTime server_default=func.now()), updated_at (DateTime onupdate=func.now()).
  b) AgencyTimeline (table agency_timeline): id (PK), user_id (String(64), nullable=False, index=True), event_type (String(64)), title (String(255)), occurs_at (DateTime), context (JSON, nullable=True), recurring (Boolean default False), recurrence_rule (String(128), nullable=True), created_at (DateTime server_default=func.now()).
  c) InitiativeSettings (table initiative_settings): id (PK), user_id (String(64), nullable=False, unique=True), level (String(32) default 'gentle_checkins'), quiet_hours_start (String(5), nullable=True), quiet_hours_end (String(5), nullable=True), updated_at (DateTime onupdate=func.now()), created_at (DateTime server_default=func.now()).
  d) Notification (table agency_notifications): id (PK matching convention), user_id (String(64), nullable=False, index=True), notif_type (String(64)), title (String(255)), body (Text), read (Boolean default False), dismissed (Boolean default False), metadata (JSON, nullable=True), created_at (DateTime server_default=func.now()).

3. Do NOT modify existing model classes, columns, imports, or the declarative base. Do NOT add foreign key constraints between new and existing tables.
